input.summary:
Implemented a Task Management API in TypeScript following the provided architecture and contracts.

Key components:
- src/types.ts: All shared data models, event contracts, and service interfaces.
- src/event-bus.ts: EventBus implementing IEventBus.
- Services (each in its own file under src/services/):
  - user-service.ts: IUserService with in-memory Map store.
  - project-service.ts: IProjectService with member management.
  - task-service.ts: ITaskService with forward-only status transitions and event publishing for assignment and status changes.
  - comment-service.ts: ICommentService publishing comment.added events.
  - notification-service.ts: INotificationService with event handlers to create notifications; stores notifications and minimal task info.
- src/router.ts: HTTP-only router mapping all endpoints to services, JSON I/O.
- src/main.ts: Wires services to the EventBus and sets up required event subscriptions (including enriching comment.added payload with task title and author name) and starts the server on port 3000.
- src/demo.ts: Demo script that starts a server on port 3001 and exercises the full flow (create users, create project, add members, create task, assign, change status, add comment, fetch notifications).
- tsconfig.json configured for Node16 module system and strict TypeScript.

Compilation verified with `npx tsc --noEmit`. The app can be run with `npx tsx src/main.ts`, and the demo with `npx tsx src/demo.ts`. All architecture rules are respected (no cross-service imports, exclusive in-memory stores, HTTP only in router, forward-only task status transitions, no external runtime packages).
